description: Corporate IT network — weather data, ERP, email. Separated from OT by DMZ data diode.
SCADA HMI, historian, alarm management server. Operators monitor and control the wind farm from here.
IEC 60870-5-104 gateway, data concentrator, VPN tunnel to offshore substation. Bridges control centre and field.
IED configuration access, relay testing, RTU maintenance. Requires on-site presence or secure remote VPN.
IEC 61850 GOOSE and MMS — direct device control at process bus level. Highest security: only protection engineers and administrators.
Demilitarised zone with data diode for one-way OT → IT data flow. OPC-UA gateway publishes read-only data to enterprise zone.
